verdict.rationale: Column documents an API-first design. Accounts, wires, ACH, RTP/FedNow, checks, international transfers, holds, reporting and webhook configuration are all exposed through APIs, and an OpenAPI spec is published. One item explicitly shows parity: webhooks can be configured via APIs or Dashboard. However, nothing states that every Dashboard capability has an API equivalent, and features such as custom roles or manual KYC review are not shown to be API-accessible. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that admin features like roles and permissions and manual KYC review are available via API, independent hands-on confirmation of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
